description: Darren Bailey finally confirmed the details of his school’s extreme curriculum, and they are even more out-of-touch than previously reported. In an interview with KSDK's Mark Maxwell, Bailey revealed that his school uses a workbook that has kids match members of a family with their roles. Students are supposed to match “husband” with “leads the family” and “wife” with “helps the husband.”
